description: The claimed novelty is already covered by prior work supplied by the researcher.

inputs.label: Prior work and contribution
inputs.content:
Supplied prior work:
[L1] Alvarez et al. 2022, "Tuned LED Spectra for Greenhouse Lettuce Growth".
     Grows lettuce under per-growth-stage LED spectra and reports biomass gains over
     a fixed white-light control. This is the closest prior work.

Our contribution:
C1: We are the first to propose changing the LED spectrum by growth stage rather than
    using a fixed spectrum for the whole cycle.
C2: Our implementation uses a different controller library than Alvarez et al.

signals.name: identifies that the closest prior work already does this
identifies the difference as implementation or parameter, not science

forbidden.name: does not accept the novelty claim
